sloka: काचिच् च वस्त्रम् अन्यस्या अपह्Rत्य उपगुह्य च ।उपगम्य अबला सुप्ता निद्रा बल पराजिता ॥५-११-२९॥
transliteration: kācic ca vastram anyasyā apahRtya upaguhya ca ।upagamya abalā suptā nidrā bala parājitā ॥5-11-29॥

translations.english: Overcome with sleep some women pulled clothes of other women and covered their bodies with them.
